description: Abort a staged matched-segment upload without confirming. Call this when the user declines to proceed after reviewing analyze_audience_upload's results. Clears the staged upload — no file move, no status/mapping-state change. The existing segment is retained; cancellation does not delete it or complete matching. Inspect it with get_segment and archive it with archive_segment if no longer needed. Idempotent. Pass exactly one of segment_id or audience_id — use audience_id when only the audience is known (it resolves to that audience's matched member segment server-side). Requires 'creator' scope.

audience_id.description: The audience_id, if segment_id isn't known
